configure.title: Configure {cover}
configure.description: Orientation and size drive the shading geometry. The cover type is pre-selected from what the cover reports it can do.

data.name: Name
data.max_penetration_depth: Allowed sun depth into the room
data.fov_left: Field of view to the left
data.fov_right: Field of view to the right
data.shade_with_window_open: Keep shading while the window is open

data_description.azimuth: Compass direction the window faces. 0 is north, 90 east, 180 south, 270 west.
data_description.max_penetration_depth: 0 m means no direct sun in the room at all, which closes the cover fully whenever the sun is on the window.
data_description.fov_left: Reduce below 90 degrees only if something real blocks the sun, such as a reveal, balcony or neighbouring building. Left is the morning side for a south-facing window.
data_description.shade_with_window_open: Off leaves the cover alone while the window is open. Turn this on only for windows that are tilted rather than opened wide, since a contact cannot tell the two apart.
data_description.seating_point: Position at which the cover has fully covered the glass. Leave empty to use the cover type default. To measure it, lower the cover slowly until the light gap at the bottom disappears.
data_description.indoor_temp_entity: A sensor, or a climate entity whose current temperature is used.

options.rolladen: Roller shutter (Rolladen), last part of travel closes the light gaps
options.other: Other, position maps directly to glass area
